headline: U.S. Early Social Security Filings Rose in 2023 Amid Agency Turmoil
summary: Experts attribute an increase in Americans filing early for Social Security benefits last year to well-publicized turmoil at the government agency.
why: The Social Security Administration oversees retirement and disability benefits for tens of millions of Americans, serving as a core pillar of U.S. entitlement spending and fiscal policy.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Early filing trends affect public entitlement expenditure and government administrative operations.
